China weekly recap. Tons happened, here's the highlights: - MXCN -0.8%, CSI300 -1.5% this past week - Xi/Trump summit concludes, as stated in my other post, Trump communicates that he will meet Xi again this year in Nov for APEC in Shenzhen in China and in Dec for G20 in Miami. After market close, Trump rejects Iran ceasefire, anticipates increased bombings after midterms - US/China delegations held 8th round of economic & trade consultations, reaching multiple consensuses. No concrete announcements yet, only summary language: "reaching consensus on multiple points including implementation of existing agreements, reciprocal tariff cuts, setting up trade and investment councils, and extending the joint arrangements reached at the consultations in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, last year" https://chinadailyhk.com/hk/article/640130 - PBOC maintained its monetary policy stance at its Q3 MPC meeting, but for the first time proposed bolstering financial support for "six networks" infrastructure - The Information reports DeepSeek's ARR has reached $1B. DS allocates 70% of its compute capacity to training and 30% to inference. It is rumored that DS is utilizing $NVDA gaming hardware to run inference on smaller models, may be why supply of RTX 5090s have dried up in the retail market - FT reports China is pursuing full stack hardware independence, including switches $AVGO - Insurance institutions eligible to trade Stock Connect stocks are permitted to invest in Stock Connect ETFs from Sep 20 - Note: A-share markets were closed on Sep 25 for the Mid-Autumn Festival and will suspend trading from 10/1-10/7 for the National Day holiday - Goldman estimates that Chinese equities could be boosted by 0.3% for each 5% decrease in US tariffs.
